chunks: Eyes lowered, shame attending. That is the day they have been promised!

key_terms.ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ: That Day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'arij is often linked to the concept of *Tajalli al-Haqq* (the Manifestation of Truth), where the disbelievers' lowered gazes signify their inability to bear the direct gaze of Divine Justice. The 'humiliation' (*dhilla*) mentioned here is not merely social disgrace but a spiritual crushing of the ego, contrasting with the dignity promised to the faithful. This moment fulfills the prophetic warnings of the Hereafter, serving as a tangible realization of the accountability discussed in the broader context of the chapter.
